shop.note: observational pace, not a forecast or causal estimate

championship.scope: everyone; student ranks remain separate in official board

current_demand_summary.rate_method: leave-one-SKU-out group shrinkage, then time-decayed own positive payments/exposure

current_demand_summary.uncertainty: Conditional sales and geometric supply scenarios; not latent-demand identification.

evaluation.note: Saved uplift over assignment baseline; inverse assignment propensity weighting; completed 6h+10m cohorts, minimum effective samples and latency guard.

buyer_objective.decision_contract: joint expected ALL progress per execution second; compare purchase/counter/outside option
buyer_objective.note: Paid Saved contributions are normalized, not absolute surplus. Pending quality is not success. Post scores are sampled from newest 100 public posts, not causal format lift or the full forum aggregate.

limitations: Equal windows are observational; market conditions, offered order mix and outages differ.
Post-v22 goods cannot have six-hour mature outcomes yet. Hidden-cost scenarios are not exact saved rewards.
Rounded board differences plus revisions of old quality outcomes do not identify a new cohort exactly.
Inventory and KV reads are at their observation times; event windows use the frozen board cutoff.
Token prices are configured estimates, not an API invoice. Cash credits are not real USD.
